- Success metrics: 40% reduction in manual triage time, avg. summary accuracy >= 90% on our eval set.
- Deliverables: PoC environment, 2 model variants, integration guide, weekly syncs.
- Pricing: pilot pricing estimate included in the attached SOW_v2.pdf.

Action items / next steps:
1) Sophie/Daniel: confirm pilot scope and timeline (target start week of Mar 22).
2) Please share the name & email of the person on your legal/procurement team who will own the contract review.
3) If you’re happy, I can send a draft with our standard redlines for faster review (happy to accept your template too).

Attaching SOW_v2.pdf for reference.

If it helps, Jonas (cc'd) can jump on a short call to walk through the integration plan next week.
